verdict.rationale: Casium states it reviews an individual's achievements and shows how strong the case is before charting a pathway. It also publishes an O-1A guide and a blog post on the principles its attorneys apply to O-1/EB-1/NIW petitions. However, nothing documents a structured, criterion-by-criterion evaluation of evidence against the O-1A USCIS criteria. Missing for 10: a documented structured O-1A assessment methodology mapped to the USCIS criteria, a sample assessment deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed

citations.quote: Casium reviews your achievements, shows you honestly how strong your case is, and lays out the pathway ahead.
the principles below explain the choices your attorney or case manager will make on your behalf.
No billable hours. No RFE or assessment fees
